resources.string: Find out whether your phone was touched while you were away.
Logs unlock attempts. Cannot lock or erase your device.
Argos only watches unlock attempts, so it can tell you if someone tried to get into your phone. It can never lock or erase your device.
Turning this off stops Argos from logging unlock attempts. The change itself is recorded.
Unlock monitoring is off. Turn it on so Argos can log unlock attempts while you are away.
Takes a snapshot of your phone.
Activity detected while you were away
Argos itself may have been tampered with
No departure is recorded: Argos was reset or its data erased while you were away.
The event journal has been altered.
The journal no longer contains your departure.
Phone unlocked at %1$s (probably you, on your return)
Unlock monitoring was turned off at %1$s
Remember these three words. Nothing to write down.
When you come back, Argos will show them to you: you\'ll only have to confirm they\'re yours.
You left on %1$s, with these words:
You didn\'t recognise this departure: someone may have reset Argos and started a fake one.
Argos\'s verification key is gone: the app was reset or reinstalled while you were away.
